This question is about rate of reaction and equilibrium.
A student investigates the rate of decomposition of aqueous hydrogen peroxide, H2O2, using
manganese(IV) oxide as a catalyst.
The equation for the reaction is shown.
2H2O2(aq)  →  2H2O(l)  +  O2(g)
